notes.title: Release Date: September 19, 2017
notes.notes:
I'm excited to announce that When It Hits the Fan will release on September 19, 2017!  Don't forget to mark as Interested or put it on your Wishlist if you intend to play it!

Features that are currently not yet implemented as of August 31st, but will be coming:

* Steam Cloud Saving
* Steam Trading Cards
* Steam Scoreboard

I will try to prioritize Trading Cards and Scoreboard before release so they are available right off the bat, but know that if they aren't in the game by release day, they will come shortly after!
